gloss: changing every month; monthly rotation; monthly special

definitions.gloss: changing every month; monthly rotation; monthly special
definitions.explanation: A schedule or arrangement in which the content, menu, or featured item is replaced with something new each month. Very common in restaurant menus, subscription boxes, magazine features, and display rotations.

examples.japanese: ⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月替|つきが}わりです。
examples.english: The lunch menu changes every month.

examples.japanese: {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザート→デザート：00036_dezaato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I look forward to the monthly dessert special.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At this cafe, you can enjoy a monthly menu that uses seasonal ingredients.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ ('month') and {替|が}わり ('change; replacement', the noun form of {替|か}わる). Parallels ⟦{日替|ひが}わり→日替わり：09745_higawari⟧ ('changing daily; daily special') and ⟦{週替|しゅうが}わり→週替わり：09824_shuugawari⟧ ('changing weekly').

USAGE:
- Most often used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧, {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧.
- Can also stand alone as a predicate: ⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{月替|つきが}わりです ('the menu changes every month').
- Implies a pleasant sense of novelty and seasonality; strongly positive in marketing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月替|つきが}わり⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧: monthly menu
- {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧: monthly lunch special
- {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザート→デザート：00036_dezaato⟧: monthly dessert special
- {月替|つきが}わり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧: to offer on a monthly rotation
- {月替|つきが}わり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧: monthly feature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日替|ひが}わり→日替わり：09745_higawari⟧: changing daily; daily special — same pattern, shorter cycle; typical of daily lunch sets and bento boxes.
- ⟦{週替|しゅうが}わり→週替わり：09824_shuugawari⟧: changing weekly; weekly special — weekly cycle, common for specials and promotions.
- ⟦{季節限定|きせつげんてい}→季節限定：09823_kisetsugentei⟧: seasonal, season-limited — tied to the four seasons rather than a fixed monthly rhythm.
- ⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧: standard item; fixed offering — the opposite concept, items that don't change over time.
